item.title: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt: the situation
item.description:
A landmine exploded near the Line of Control in Azad Kashmir killing four men. A man was injured in a bear attack in South Kashmir. In Manipur two militants were arrested for extortion and Makui Village Authority condemned firing, demanding immediate security intervention. Security forces in Chhattisgarh recovered firearms and detonators from a Maoist dump in Sukma while the state chief minister agreed in principle to reduce security deployment in the Siang Valley. The conflict produced 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
